text:
maya: Quick thread to finalize the 'Express Onboard' acceptance and rollout plan. Customers want faster turnups + clear gates.
ravi: core asks?
maya: 1) onboarding time <= 48h for small cohorts, 2) production listing requires perf+quality checks, 3) air-gapped flow needs Ops support.
sophia: proposal: two lanes — Express (preview) and Stable (prod). Express: 48h, relaxed SLOs, quota caps. Stable: pinned version, automated eval pass & canary.
kevin: suggested acceptance metrics for Stable: p95 <= 200ms @512 tokens on hosted, token-cost delta <= +25% vs baseline, eval regression <= 3% on our standard prompts.
sophia: also require telemetry: token-level cost + trace sampling enabled by default for canaries.
ops-bot: created checklist RW-PL-1202: https://redwood.internal/checklists/express-onboard (auto-post)
ravi: infra notes: validating quant profiles ~1 dev-day/model on Dedicated; need nightly stability job.
maya: canary recipe: 2% traffic for 72h, gates: no >2% spike errors, p95 <1.3x baseline, eval dip <2%. Auto-rollback on serious breaches.
kevin: define rollback triggers: sustained p95 >2x baseline for >15m, error rate >3%, eval regression >5% -> auto-swap to previous pinned.
sophia: add dashboard: cohort health score (p95/error/eval quality) for go/no-go.
ravi: owners: Ravi = infra/pinning, Sophia = canary SLOs + alarms, Maya = docs + customer table.
kevin: marketing asks: one-pager + pricing table mapping Express vs Stable by EOW.
maya: Action items captured. I'll draft the acceptance doc and internal runbook and share for review. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: created ticket RW-PL-1203: "Express onboard pilot - 3 models"
kevin: let's pilot with three models next sprint: small L2 open, mid encoder-decoder, customer quantized variant.
maya: thanks all, will follow up with draft and timeline.
